definition: φελόνης (Rec. φαιλ-), -ου, ὁ  by metath. for παινόλης (also φενόλης, φαινόλιον; Lat. pænula)  a cloak (see DCG, i, 338; on the idea that the meaning here is book-cover, see CGT, in l; Milligan, NTD, 20; Field, Notes, 217 f., where the view that the φ. here is an eccl. vestment is discussed): 2Ti.4:13.† (AS)
